name: Speed Bitcoin and Stablecoin Payments for WooCommerce
author: Speed

sections.description:
Accept Bitcoin and stablecoin payments on your WooCommerce store, instantly over the Lightning Network or on-chain, with fast, low-cost, and borderless transactions.

Speed offers a secure, white-label crypto payment plugin that’s easy to install and even easier to use. Set up the plugin in under a minute to start accepting Bitcoin and Stablecoins like USDT or USDC from customers worldwide. Drive more sales, attract global crypto users, and grow your business revenue effortlessly. Click here to learn more.

There are no hidden charges, setup fees, or ongoing maintenance costs. Speed operates in 21+ countries and supports 100+ languages, making it simple for your brand to go global without barriers. The Speed Payments for WooCommerce extension is compatible with over 100 Bitcoin, Lightning, and stablecoin wallets, ensuring a smooth integration and seamless checkout experience.

With the Speed plugin, you can offer your customers a secure, branded, and user-friendly Bitcoin and Stablecoin checkout, enabling instant payments in just a few minutes, all while keeping your current WooCommerce operations simple, fast, and cost-efficient.

Why choose Speed?

Experience a faster, simpler, and more flexible way to accept Bitcoin and Stablecoin payments on WooCommerce.

  1. There are no hidden fees, setup costs, or maintenance charges, only payments made easy.
  2. Eliminate the risk of chargebacks and fraudulent transactions with transparent blockchain verification.
  3. Accept global payments in Bitcoin and stablecoins like USDT or USDC, without a bank or a middleman.
  4. Withdraw your balance instantly in Bitcoin or stablecoins just standard network fees apply.
  5. Setup takes less than a minute. Simply create a Speed account and install the plugin to start receiving payments.
  6. Enjoy a secure, private, and fully compliant payment experience for both you and your customers.
  7. Benefit from real-time conversion and exchange rate updates for accurate Bitcoin and stablecoin payments.

Create your Speed account today and start accepting crypto payments instantly.

How does it work?

  1. The customers add products to the cart and proceed to the Speed Bitcoin and Stablecoin checkout page.
  2. A dynamic QR code payment screen appears, where they can easily scan or copy the Lightning invoice or wallet address to complete the payment.
  3. Speed locks in the real-time exchange rate for 10 minutes, ensuring no volatility in Bitcoin or stablecoin pricing.
  4. Once the payment is confirmed on the blockchain, you’ll receive an instant confirmation directly on your Speed dashboard.
  5. You can choose to withdraw your balance in Bitcoin or stablecoins, either manually or through automated daily payouts.

Features of Speed

  1. Ready to use, high-conversion payment page for seamless Bitcoin and stablecoin transactions.
  2. Fully customizable checkout page to match your brand guidelines and create a consistent customer experience.
  3. Web app for real-time tracking of payments and instant transaction confirmations.
  4. Instant Stablecoin-to-Bitcoin and Bitcoin-to-stablecoin conversion at competitive rates.
  5. No transaction fees for accepting Bitcoin and Stablecoin payments a completely free-to-use platform.
  6. Easy integration testing by switching transactions between live and test modes.
  7. Multi-asset payment support for Bitcoin, USDT, USDC, and more across multiple networks, including Lightning, ERC20, and TRC20.

About Speed

Speed is committed to providing a secure and user-friendly platform for businesses and individuals to accept and send Bitcoin and Stablecoin payments. Speed’s goal is to empower businesses to adapt effortlessly to the growing demand for cryptocurrency payments by offering tailored solutions across industries and business types. We are a robust payment infrastructure that enables smooth transactions in both Bitcoin and stablecoins.

Speed does not charge fees for accepting Bitcoin or stablecoin payments. When withdrawing your balance to an external wallet, only a nominal Lightning Network routing fee applies.
sections.installation:
Requirements

To install Speed Bitcoin Payments for WooCommerce Plugin, you need:

  • WordPress Version 4.0 or newer (installed). Tested up to: 6.8.3.
  • WooCommerce Version 3.9 or newer (installed and activated).
  • PHP Version 7.4.29 or newer.
  • Speed account. If you don’t already have a Speed account, sign up for one here.

Install

  1. Log in to WordPress Admin.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for the WooCommerce Speed Bitcoin Payments plugin. The author is Speed.
  4. Click on Install Now and wait until the plugin is installed successfully.
  5. You can activate the plugin immediately by clicking on Activate now on the success page. If you want to activate it later, you can do so via Plugins > Installed Plugins.

To learn more, see Installing and Managing Plugins.

Test & Live Mode

Enable Test Mode, where in you can simulate multiple payments to ensure it is functioning correctly before accepting real ones. Once you are ready to accept actual payments, switch to Live Mode.

To learn about Setup and configuration, click here
sections.faq:
Where can I find the documentation?

You can access our complete developer documentation here to explore integration guides, APIs, and technical resources.

Can I customize the checkout page?

Yes! You can fully customize your checkout page by adding your logo, brand colors, and icons. Simply go to Web App > Settings > Branding to personalize your payment experience.

How do I test the plugin?

You can enable the plugin’s test mode to simulate transactions safely before going live. This helps you ensure your integration works perfectly. Learn more in our testing guide

Can I use this plug-in on more than one site?

Yes! You can install and use the Speed plugin on multiple business websites without any restrictions.

Who can use Speed?

Speed is designed for business owners who sell products or services online. We provide multiple solutions to help you easily integrate a Bitcoin and stablecoin checkout into your e-commerce store, making crypto payments simple and seamless.
